## Modules

- [TimelessLogs](https://timeless-logs.hexdocs.pm/TimelessLogs.md): Embedded log compression and indexing for Elixir applications.
- [TimelessLogs.DB](https://timeless-logs.hexdocs.pm/TimelessLogs.DB.md): SQLite connection manager with a single writer and pooled readers.
- [TimelessLogs.Entry](https://timeless-logs.hexdocs.pm/TimelessLogs.Entry.md): A single log entry.

- [TimelessLogs.HTTP](https://timeless-logs.hexdocs.pm/TimelessLogs.HTTP.md): Optional HTTP interface compatible with VictoriaLogs.
- [TimelessLogs.LogsQL](https://timeless-logs.hexdocs.pm/TimelessLogs.LogsQL.md): Parser for the subset of LogsQL that DDNet sends.
- [TimelessLogs.Result](https://timeless-logs.hexdocs.pm/TimelessLogs.Result.md): Query result with pagination metadata.

- [TimelessLogs.Stats](https://timeless-logs.hexdocs.pm/TimelessLogs.Stats.md): Aggregate statistics about stored log data.

- [TimelessLogs.Telemetry](https://timeless-logs.hexdocs.pm/TimelessLogs.Telemetry.md): Telemetry events emitted by TimelessLogs.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix timeless_logs.benchmark](https://timeless-logs.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.TimelessLogs.Benchmark.md): Benchmark compression rates with realistic Phoenix log data
- [mix timeless_logs.index_benchmark](https://timeless-logs.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.TimelessLogs.IndexBenchmark.md): Benchmark pure ETS index operations in isolation (no disk I/O)
- [mix timeless_logs.ingest_benchmark](https://timeless-logs.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.TimelessLogs.IngestBenchmark.md): Benchmark ingestion throughput through the full pipeline
- [mix timeless_logs.search_benchmark](https://timeless-logs.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.TimelessLogs.SearchBenchmark.md): Benchmark search speed across query patterns on a week of indexed Phoenix logs
